supercharger_access.notes: Quick web lookup. Canadian article (Sept 2024) on the GM NACS adapter for Canadian owners of Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ. Says nothing about 2026 trim ports.

charge_port.notes: Page: the 2026 car kept its CCS1 port (US). thinkEV (Canada) says the 2027 LYRIQ trades the CCS connector on current models for NACS; EVChargingStations says earlier years used CCS1. Conflicts with OpenEV (nacs, probably 2027 data). No Canadian GM page read.

wheels.notes: US Cars.com: LYRIQ-V 22 in, 275/40R22. A Canadian snippet reportedly mentioned 20 in; not confirmed.
